title: AI can knock on the door. Your CRM marketing platform is still the house.
cover_headline: AI assistants are smart. They're not your CRM.
cover_body: Why ChatGPT plugging into your platform doesn't make the platform optional.

slides.headline: The house, the door, the visitor
slides.body: AI assistant = visitor. MCP connection = door. Your CRM platform = the house where all the value actually lives.

slides.headline: Smart enough to know what it lacks
slides.body: Ask AI which customers might churn. It reasons well — but the answer comes from your platform's data. Take that away, it's standing in an empty lot.

slides.headline: "We'll build it ourselves" — slow down
slides.body: Technical teams see an easy wire-up. But building an audience isn't a query — it's years of judgment calls a general model hasn't lived through.

slides.headline: Not competitors. Parts of one system.
slides.body: Assistant handles reasoning and conversation. Platform holds data, decisioning, what works. MCP connects them. Remove any one — value collapses.

slides.headline: Already in production, not theory
slides.body: Teams draft a week of campaigns in 90 minutes. Agents flag broken journeys before anyone arrives. Small teams run like big ones.

cta_body: AI can knock — but if there's nothing behind the door, there's nothing to capture. LeadYup turns your site into the house worth entering.
